title: Searching a folder tree
hints: For the wildcard, remember the position of the last `*` and where in the name it started matching; when a character fails, go back there and let the `*` take one more character.
Make the walk a recursive function that returns `false` when the search was stopped, so every level can return at once without searching on.
requirements: Wildcards match like Windows, ignoring case, including the `*.*` rule and lists of patterns.
The walk order is deterministic, `.` and `..` are ignored, and links are never followed.
Depth, size and directory options work as described.
The search stops exactly when the callback says so.
stretch: Add searching inside files for a text (with a size limit and a "binary file" check), and report progress every 200 visits by posting the current folder's path to the window.
